commuters.label: COMMUTERS
commuters.heading: Know before you drive into a market-day jam.
commuters.body: On market day, the roads around a market fill with traders, buyers and loading trucks. Marketdey tells you the evening before, so you can leave early or take another road.

shoppers.label: MARKET-DAY SHOPPERS
shoppers.heading: Shop on the day the market is full.
shoppers.body: Market day brings traders in from nearby farms and towns, so there's more to choose from and more room to haggle. Follow the markets near you and Marketdey tells you when each one is on.

seekers.label: BARGAIN SEEKERS
seekers.heading: Go to the market known for what you need.
seekers.body: Some markets are known for one thing, like yams in one town and fabric in the next. Search by what you want to buy, see how far it is, and arrive on the right day.
